text:
Eleanor Park: quick thought  launching the SI onboarding cert pilot next month. goal: 6 SIs, 2 partner cloud listings (AWS Marketplace + NexusCloud), and a hardware partner lab window. want a lightweight cert path + mentor shadow week. thoughts? :rocket:
Diego Ramos: +1. for marketplace listing readiness we need a stubbed deployment guide and an integration checklist. can the SIs ship a quick terraform module as part of the lab?
Lina Chen: terraform module is good but keep it optional. propose 3 certification gates: self-study (docs + quiz), infra exercise (deploy + smoke test), and proctored capstone (live troubleshooting). each gate should have clear pass/fail rubrics.
Omar Khan: proctored capstone raises recording & data concerns. for cloud-hosted labs require signed AUP and minimal logs retention policy. i'll draft a privacy blurb and a consent template.
Eleanor Park: timeline idea: week 1 = self-study + quiz; week 2 = infra exercise with hardware windows; week 3 = mentor shadow + proctored capstone. mentors run 2 cohorts/week. we have NexusCloud racks reserved: 2024-09-09..2024-09-16 and 2024-10-07..2024-10-14.
Diego Ramos: i'm confirming AWS listing sandbox for the infra exercise. also coordinating a partner credit allocation for SI teams who complete certs.
Lina Chen: mentor ops: need a one-pager w/ escalation matrix and a short script for common lab issues. sample escalation snippet: 
```
Issue: model OOM on quantized config
Action: switch to 8-bit profile, restart runtime with --kv-cache=on, notify mentor channel
```
Eleanor Park: nice. add participant timezone distro to roster so mentors can be scheduled across APAC/EMEA/NA. Diego, can you collect SI prefered windows?
Diego Ramos: will collect today. CSV template i'll ask them to fill: 
```
si_name, contact, timezone, preferred_lab_windows, cloud_listing_interest
Acme Integrators, ops@acme.com, EU/CET, 2024-09-10 14:00-17:00, AWS
```
Omar Khan: note on recordings: consent checkbox must be explicit and stored with minimal metadata only. redact IPs in logs and delete raw recordings after 30 days unless SI opts-in to share for training.
Lina Chen: assessment infra: prefer an automated harness for the infra exercise (checks: endpoint reachable, latency <200ms, correct model variant). can we reuse the internal smoke-checker?
Eleanor Park: yes, devex said we can expose a trimmed smoke-checker. Lina, can you draft the assessment checklist + scoring thresholds by Fri?
Lina Chen: on it. will include pass conditions and partial credit rules. also adding a mentor rubric for live grading (communication, troubleshooting, accuracy).
onboarding-bot: poll created: "Preferred mentor shift length" options: 1-week, 2-week, 3-week. please vote. link: https://poll.redwood.ai/mentor-shift
Diego Ramos: vote: 2-week. fewer handoffs, better continuity.
Omar Khan: 1-week preferred for coverage but ok with 2-week if mentor pool is larger.
Eleanor Park: planning recap: Lina = playbook + assessment checklist, Diego = SI roster + marketplace sandbox confirmation, Omar = AUP + redaction policy. target: ship pilot run dates and playbook by Mon 2024-08-12 (1749100800). final readout w/ SI leads Tue.
Lina Chen: flag: potential conflict with product release week 36 for some mentors. will propose standby mentors.
Diego Ramos: adding a short FAQ for SIs about cloud credits, hardware SLAs, and caching quotas. will drop in partnership drive.
Eleanor Park: thanks team. if anyone wants to join the mentoring panel, DM me. :raised_hands:
